item.name: Captain Stephen
item.whereFound: One of three Survivor Islands each run (radio-marked)
item.howToInteract: Clear island pressure, walk up, and interact to rescue. He teleports to your base and starts working.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Island guards (often Ghost Pirates) must be cleared before a safe rescue.
item.dropsOrRewards: Each rescued Survivor adds +1 Day Multiplier and automates base machines and material processing.
item.relatedSystem: Survivor Islands, radio map marks, base automation
item.cardSummary: One of three named Survivors with the same rescue payoff. Free him on his Survivor Island for Day Multiplier and long-run base automation.

item.name: Doctor Madelaine
item.whereFound: One of three Survivor Islands each run (radio-marked)
item.howToInteract: Clear island pressure, walk up, and interact to rescue. She teleports to your base and starts working.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Island guards (often Ghost Pirates) must be cleared before a safe rescue.
item.dropsOrRewards: Each rescued Survivor adds +1 Day Multiplier and automates base machines and material processing.
item.relatedSystem: Survivor Islands, radio map marks, base automation
item.cardSummary: One of three named Survivors with the same rescue payoff. Free her on her Survivor Island for Day Multiplier and long-run base automation.

item.name: Professor Erik
item.whereFound: One of three Survivor Islands each run (radio-marked)
item.howToInteract: Clear island pressure, walk up, and interact to rescue. He teleports to your base and starts working.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Island guards (often Ghost Pirates) must be cleared before a safe rescue.
item.dropsOrRewards: Each rescued Survivor adds +1 Day Multiplier and automates base machines and material processing.
item.relatedSystem: Survivor Islands, radio map marks, base automation
item.cardSummary: One of three named Survivors with the same rescue payoff. Free him on his Survivor Island for Day Multiplier and long-run base automation.

item.name: Fisherman
item.whereFound: Fisherman Island, the large landmass next to the starting raft
item.howToInteract: Defeat Buku guards on the island, then interact to free him. After rescue, trade cooked fish dishes for gear in a fixed order.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Early Buku warriors guard the island approach.
item.dropsOrRewards: Rescue grants a Fishing Rod for every player and unlocks a hut chest that holds a Dinghy. Trades include Crab Trap, Machete, Good Sack, Flintlock, Chowder, Flare, Doubloons, Blunderbuss, Giant Sack, and Swordfish Sword for specific fish dishes.
item.relatedSystem: Fisherman Island, fishing progression, early boat and tool unlocks
item.cardSummary: Top early priority. Free him for fishing gear and the Dinghy path, then climb the fixed fish-for-loot trade ladder when you have food to spare.

item.name: MukuMuku Merchant
item.whereFound: Sails up beside your base during the day and leaves at night
item.howToInteract: Spend Doubloons at his ship shop. Stock is limited per player and purchased lines do not restock on later visits.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Missing him at night means waiting for the next daytime visit.
item.dropsOrRewards: Doubloons-only shop with limited stock. High-value leads include Medkits (revive), Pearls, Rifle, Ghost Sack, plus boats, weapons, building materials, and Corrupt Shards.
item.relatedSystem: Doubloons economy, revives, Pearl spending path outside Companion Shop
item.cardSummary: Daytime Doubloons trader with one-time stock per player. Plan medkits, Pearls, and key gear buys instead of impulse spending.

item.name: Glorbus
item.whereFound: One of the Alien Islands
item.howToInteract: Feed him 20 food items of any kind. He then rewards the Alien Food Machine.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Reach him only after Alien Island combat pressure is under control.
item.dropsOrRewards: Alien Food Machine turns five food items into Alien Soup, which restores more hunger than regular Chowder.
item.relatedSystem: Alien Islands, food crafting. Placed machines can be auto-fed by rescued Survivors.
item.cardSummary: Alien Island food NPC. Trade a large food dump for the Alien Food Machine, then decide carefully where to place it so Survivors do not auto-feed premium meals.

item.name: Lost Penguin
item.whereFound: Scattered across Ice Region islands when the map has an Ice Biome (20 total)
item.howToInteract: Find each Lost Penguin on ice islands and return it to the Penguin Mother.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged. Ice Region wildlife and travel risk are the real danger while collecting.
item.dropsOrRewards: Progress toward the full Ice penguin hand-in that unlocks the Yeti boss path.
item.relatedSystem: Ice Region, Penguin Mother, Yeti boss (bosses collection). Not the Companion Shop Penguin pet.
item.cardSummary: Ice Biome collectibles. Return all 20 to the Penguin Mother to open the Yeti route. Separate from the Companion Shop penguin pet.

item.name: Penguin Mother
item.whereFound: Ice Region when the map spawns with an Ice Biome
item.howToInteract: Deliver all 20 Lost Penguins to her. Completing the set spawns the Yeti boss path.
item.threatNotes: Cannot be damaged.
item.dropsOrRewards: Completing deliveries triggers the Yeti encounter path rather than a direct loot drop here.
item.relatedSystem: Ice Region penguin quest. Yeti fight details live on the bosses collection.
item.cardSummary: Turn-in NPC for the Ice penguin rescue set. Finish all deliveries to unlock Yeti; do not treat her as a combat target.

item.name: Ghost Pirate
item.whereFound: Pirate islands, cauldron treasure islands, Ghost Galleon boards, pirate raids, pirate strongholds
item.howToInteract: Fight with melee or ranged weapons. Collect bodies when you need ghost-pirate crafting inputs.
item.threatNotes: Transparent green sword pirates that swarm early, including the guaranteed first-night raid. Prefer range when many spawn at once.
item.dropsOrRewards: Essences for potions are a common lead. Night raids also grant Glue per pirate kill for crafting table use.
item.relatedSystem: Ghost pirate night raids, strongholds, Ghost Galleon content. Not Captain Greenbeard or the Galleon boss card.
item.cardSummary: Core ghost-pirate melee unit and first-night raid filler. Farm them for Essences and Glue, and clear them before boarding harder pirate structures.

item.name: Ghost Pirate Gunner
item.whereFound: Pirate islands, Ghost Galleon, pirate raids, pirate strongholds
item.howToInteract: Keep moving while closing or answering with your own ranged weapons.
item.threatNotes: Transparent green rifle or gun pirates. Bullets punish standing still more than pure melee ghosts do.
item.dropsOrRewards: Same pirate-group leads as other ghosts: Essences and raid Glue when killed during raids.
item.relatedSystem: Ghost pirate raids and ship boards
item.cardSummary: Ranged ghost-pirate variant. Strafe their shots, then clear them before they shred raft walls or your health during raids.

item.name: Ghost Bombardier
item.whereFound: Ghost Galleon and higher-day pirate raids
item.howToInteract: Watch the ground marker, step out of the blast zone, then punish after the shot.
item.threatNotes: Transparent green boomstick pirates that telegraph an AoE impact zone before firing.
item.dropsOrRewards: Pirate-group Essences and raid Glue leads.
item.relatedSystem: High-day pirate raids, Ghost Galleon boarding fights
item.cardSummary: AoE ghost-pirate variant on galleon and late pirate raids. Leave the telegraphed blast circle, then finish them with ranged fire.

item.name: Ghost Pirate Captain
item.whereFound: High-day pirate raids and pirate strongholds
item.howToInteract: Prefer ranged weapons and extra healing. Do not confuse this regular elite with the named Greenbeard boss.
item.threatNotes: Larger dual-sword green ghost with more HP and damage than standard pirates.
item.dropsOrRewards: Pirate-group Essences and raid Glue leads. Boss-grade cutlass rewards belong to the separate Greenbeard / Galleon boss path.
item.relatedSystem: Pirate raids and strongholds. Distinct from Captain Greenbeard and Ghost Galleon boss cards.
item.cardSummary: Elite dual-sword ghost pirate on late raids and strongholds. Treat as a tough regular unit, not the named Captain Greenbeard boss entry.

item.name: Buku Buku
item.whereFound: Many early islands and Buku raids (can appear with little warning, even by day)
item.howToInteract: Basic melee clear. Safe to farm early for chests and island control.
item.threatNotes: Masked humanoids in yellow-blue gear with swords. Low threat compared with pirates and later elites.
item.dropsOrRewards: Early island chests and general loot pressure. Buku raids are low-damage skirmishes.
item.relatedSystem: Early island clears, Buku night or day raids, Fisherman Island guards
item.cardSummary: Default Buku Tribe melee fighter and early-island staple. Clear them for island access and light raid value.

item.name: Buku Boku
item.whereFound: Buku-held islands and Buku raids
item.howToInteract: Close distance or answer with guns so archers cannot free-fire from cover.
item.threatNotes: Masked humanoids in green-blue gear with bows.
item.dropsOrRewards: Tribe loot and chests. Raid sources note a possible sword drop from Boku-named fighters.
item.relatedSystem: Buku raids and early island combat
item.cardSummary: Bow-using Buku variant. Prioritize them when they sit behind melee tribe members on early islands and raids.

item.name: Buku Poku
item.whereFound: Buku-held islands and Buku raids
item.howToInteract: Fight like other tribe melee units, then check the body for the rare weapon lead.
item.threatNotes: Fish-masked humanoids in red-yellow gear with spears.
item.dropsOrRewards: Chance to drop the Poku Poku weapon.
item.relatedSystem: Buku Tribe loot path, weapons progression
item.cardSummary: Spear Buku variant with the Poku Poku weapon lead. Worth killing on sight when you are still building a mid-run melee kit.

item.name: Buku Toku
item.whereFound: High-day Buku raids
item.howToInteract: Expect a tankier tribe fighter. Break them with sustained damage rather than ignoring them for softer targets.
item.threatNotes: Fish-masked red-yellow fighters with shield and spear. Appear more often on tougher Buku waves.
item.dropsOrRewards: Tribe raid loot. No unique guaranteed drop published beyond standard Buku combat rewards.
item.relatedSystem: High-day Buku raids
item.cardSummary: Shielded Buku elite on harder raids. Higher durability than basic Buku Buku, still lower overall pressure than late pirates or corruption packs.

item.name: Rival Survivor (Melee)
item.whereFound: Rival Rigs and Radio Tower islands
item.howToInteract: Clear aggressively but with healing ready. Loot the platform after the fight.
item.threatNotes: Hostile humans with swords or knives. Loadout can vary by location (for example ghost cutlass on larger rigs).
item.dropsOrRewards: High-tier weapons, Doubloon chests, and armor leads from cleared rigs and towers.
item.relatedSystem: Rival Rigs set, Radio Towers chain
item.cardSummary: Melee rival defender on rigs and radio towers. Expect strong platform loot after the clear, not a free early farm.

item.name: Rival Survivor (Ranged)
item.whereFound: Rival Rigs and Radio Tower islands
item.howToInteract: Stay mobile, use cover, and answer with ranged weapons when possible.
item.threatNotes: Hostile humans with guns. Standing still on open platforms is punished hard.
item.dropsOrRewards: Same high-tier weapons, Doubloon chests, and armor leads as melee rivals after a full clear.
item.relatedSystem: Rival Rigs set, Radio Towers chain
item.cardSummary: Gun rival defender on the same structures as melee rivals. Keep moving while you clear towers and the three-rig objective set.

item.name: Corrupt Crewmate
item.whereFound: Corrupted structures such as the Cargo Ship
item.howToInteract: Bring mid-to-late weapons and healing. Clear rooms carefully instead of rushing.
item.threatNotes: Purple-transparent military humanoids with axes. High HP and hard hits compared with early islands.
item.dropsOrRewards: Corruption weapon leads such as Saber, Revolver, and Corrupt Minigun from the broader corrupt set.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Basic corruption melee unit in cargo and corrupted rooms. Expect tankier fights than Buku or early pirates.

item.name: Corrupt Officer
item.whereFound: Corrupted structures such as the Cargo Ship
item.howToInteract: Prioritize while moving so gunfire does not stack with melee crewmates.
item.threatNotes: Purple-transparent military gunners mixed into corruption packs.
item.dropsOrRewards: Corruption weapon leads shared with the corrupt set.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Ranged corruption officer. Drop them early in mixed rooms so crewmates cannot pin you under gunfire.

item.name: Corrupt Saber Yielder
item.whereFound: Corrupted structures such as the Cargo Ship
item.howToInteract: Keep distance if possible and do not trade hits carelessly.
item.threatNotes: Purple humanoid with a laser saber. Higher pressure melee elite inside corruption spaces.
item.dropsOrRewards: Saber-class corruption loot is a soft lead from this family.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Saber-wielding corruption elite. One of the reasons cargo clears need real weapons and healing, not starter tools.

item.name: Corrupt Minigunner
item.whereFound: Corrupted structures such as the Cargo Ship
item.howToInteract: Break line of sight, peek damage, and avoid long open corridors.
item.threatNotes: Purple humanoid in yellow gear with a minigun. Sustained ranged pressure.
item.dropsOrRewards: Corrupt Minigun is a soft lead from the corruption enemy family.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Heavy gun corruption elite. Treat as a priority target when clearing cargo rooms with limited cover.

item.name: Chest Mimic
item.whereFound: Corrupted structures such as the Cargo Ship
item.howToInteract: Approach suspicious chests ready to fight instead of assuming free loot.
item.threatNotes: Chest body with an eye and teeth. Ambush threat mixed into corruption loot routes.
item.dropsOrRewards: Corruption combat loot after the fake chest is defeated.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Fake chest that fights back. Open cargo loot carefully and keep a weapon ready on any odd chest model.

item.name: Red Jellyfish
item.whereFound: Corrupted rooms and related corruption spaces
item.howToInteract: Clear with mid-range weapons. Avoid walking through packs of jellies while low on health.
item.threatNotes: Human-sized red jelly that floats slightly above ground.
item.dropsOrRewards: Corruption room combat loot. No unique public drop table isolated for color variants.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Red floating jelly inside corruption spaces. Clear them so they do not chip you while you handle humanoid corrupt packs.

item.name: Blue Jellyfish
item.whereFound: Corrupted rooms and related corruption spaces
item.howToInteract: Clear with mid-range weapons alongside red jellies and humanoid corrupt packs.
item.threatNotes: Human-sized blue jelly that floats slightly above ground.
item.dropsOrRewards: Corruption room combat loot. No unique public drop table isolated for color variants.
item.relatedSystem: Corruption / Cargo Ship content
item.cardSummary: Blue floating jelly variant in the same corruption rooms as the red jelly. Same job: clear space before the humanoid elites stack damage.

item.name: Alien
item.whereFound: Alien raids on your base and Alien Islands
item.howToInteract: Clear raid waves for the Transponder path, then fight island aliens with strong mid-to-late gear.
item.threatNotes: Small green aliens beam down from UFOs in raids. Island packs hit harder and should not be rushed undergeared.
item.dropsOrRewards: Clearing an alien raid can drop an Alien Transponder used to locate Alien Islands. Island fights can lead to Energy Sword drops.
item.relatedSystem: Alien raids, Alien Transponder, Alien Islands, Glorbus. Not a player class.
item.cardSummary: Base alien unit for raids and Alien Islands. Raid clears open the Transponder route; island packs are among the harder regular hostiles.

item.name: Alien Warrior
item.whereFound: Later alien raids and Alien Islands
item.howToInteract: Keep distance, use cover, and do not treat late alien raids like the weak early UFO waves.
item.threatNotes: Tougher alien fighters that mix into higher-day raids and island defenses. Damage can approach ghost-pirate pressure.
item.dropsOrRewards: Alien combat loot and Energy Sword soft leads from the alien enemy family.
item.relatedSystem: Alien raids and islands. Name collides with the Alien Warrior class loadout; this card is the world mob only.
item.cardSummary: Elite alien world enemy on later raids and islands. Separate from the Alien Warrior player class with the same name.

item.name: Shark
item.whereFound: Open ocean around boats and islands
item.howToInteract: Avoid unnecessary water fights. Outrun when undergeared; only fight with real weapons if you must.
item.threatNotes: Can knock you off boats and deal instant-feeling water damage. Riskier than land Buku packs for early rafts.
item.dropsOrRewards: No stable public per-kill table listed in primary guides. Survival is the main reward early.
item.relatedSystem: Open-sea travel. Not the Companion Shop Shark pet.
item.cardSummary: Open-sea predator that punishes bad boat fights. Prefer evasion early, and do not confuse this world shark with the Companion Shop pet.

item.name: Salamander
item.whereFound: Open ocean
item.howToInteract: Treat as a rare sea threat. Outrun unless you are geared for open-water combat.
item.threatNotes: Sea monster that can knock players off boats and punish exposed swims.
item.dropsOrRewards: No stable public per-kill table listed in primary guides.
item.relatedSystem: Open-sea travel. Not the Companion Shop Salamander pet.
item.cardSummary: Rarer open-sea monster alongside sharks and angler fish. Avoid casual fights while your raft is still fragile.

item.name: Angler Fish
item.whereFound: Open ocean, especially dangerous at night if the bonfire is out
item.howToInteract: Keep the bonfire lit and avoid night chases when possible. Do not bait it without a retreat plan.
item.threatNotes: Community guides flag it as one of the most dangerous sea threats, able to chase hard when night defenses fail.
item.dropsOrRewards: No stable public per-kill table listed in primary guides. Keeping the run alive is the real reward.
item.relatedSystem: Night survival, bonfire upkeep, open-sea travel
item.cardSummary: Top open-sea chase threat, especially when night lights fail. Outrun and secure the bonfire rather than farming it for loot.

item.name: Wolf
item.whereFound: Ice Region islands when the map has an ice biome
item.howToInteract: Fight only with mid-to-late weapons and healing. Do not treat ice wildlife like early Buku packs.
item.threatNotes: Among the tougher land animals in cold regions.
item.dropsOrRewards: No isolated public drop table beyond general Ice Region combat loot.
item.relatedSystem: Ice Region exploration. Distinct from the Companion Shop Arctic Wolf pet.
item.cardSummary: Ice Region hostile animal. Expect harder fights than early islands while you collect penguins or push toward Yeti prep.

item.name: Polar Bear
item.whereFound: Ice Region islands when the map has an ice biome
item.howToInteract: Keep distance, use strong weapons, and avoid multi-bear pulls.
item.threatNotes: High-pressure ice wildlife among the toughest non-boss land fights.
item.dropsOrRewards: No isolated public drop table beyond general Ice Region combat loot.
item.relatedSystem: Ice Region exploration. Distinct from the Companion Shop Polar Bear pet.
item.cardSummary: Heavy Ice Region animal threat. Clear carefully while hunting Lost Penguins; this is not a Companion Shop pet card.

item.name: Magma Snail
item.whereFound: Volcano / magma biome spaces
item.howToInteract: Engage only when prepared for volcano-region combat pressure.
item.threatNotes: Biome-specific magma wildlife listed among the harder non-boss land threats.
item.dropsOrRewards: No isolated public drop table beyond general volcano-region combat loot.
item.relatedSystem: Volcano Region. Fire Golems and Lord of Lava stay on the bosses collection. Distinct from Companion Shop Lava Snail.
item.cardSummary: Volcano-region wildlife, not the Fire Golems mini-boss trio. Clear only with real mid-run gear while traveling the magma route.

item.name: Seagull
item.whereFound: Low sky around the map, reachable with harpoon or guns
item.howToInteract: Harpoon or shoot for a one-shot kill. Harpooning can drag cooked bird meat back to you.
item.threatNotes: Non-hostile. Lowest combat threat in the game.
item.dropsOrRewards: Cooked bird food on death (already cooked).
item.relatedSystem: Emergency food. Distinct from the Companion Shop Seagull pet.
item.cardSummary: Passive sky bird you can harpoon for quick cooked food. Not hostile and not the Companion Shop seagull.

item.name: Crow
item.whereFound: Low sky around the map, reachable with harpoon or guns
item.howToInteract: Harpoon or shoot for a one-shot kill. Harpooning can drag cooked bird meat back to you.
item.threatNotes: Non-hostile. Lowest combat threat in the game.
item.dropsOrRewards: Cooked bird food on death (already cooked).
item.relatedSystem: Emergency food. Distinct from the Companion Shop Crow pet.
item.cardSummary: Passive sky bird twin to the seagull for emergency cooked food. Not hostile and not the Companion Shop crow.
